decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the reusable-background and translatable-text strategy for iOS, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The candidate already established the same tutorial-image strategy at message 46; message 49 confirms it without changing the candidate's current state.
Separating translatable text from reusable tutorial backgrounds changes asset handling, not the requirement to localize the full Android application.
The tutorial asset strategy does not change the independently required right-to-left layout behavior.
The localized-image optimization does not alter Android OS compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
Using reusable backgrounds with separately rendered translations does not alter the scope or scale of iOS full-app localization.
The tutorial asset strategy has no effect on the requirement to remove unused Android permissions.
The image and text asset strategy does not change iOS framework modernization or deprecated-API refactoring requirements.
The localized tutorial asset decision is unrelated to the requirement for an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The tutorial asset strategy does not affect iOS signing certificates or signing configuration.
